This is the most pressing coordination issue. - **[Issue #54](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/54)** (Surge deployment fixes) and **[Issue #50](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/50)** (Surge preview hosting) are both CLOSED.
